summary: P0 verification of Mirror Knowledge Graph V1.5 relationship_synthesis backend payload contract + frontend bundle freshness + forum_hd_mapping integration. All 45 backend tests pass (14 new payload-contract tests + 31 existing V1.5 KG tests: test_mirror_kg_v15.py 14, test_mirror_kg_overlay.py 17). Version markers correct (mirror-signal-normalizer-v1.5, mirror-knowledge-graph-v1.5, mirror-reflection-orchestrator-v1.5). synthesize_relationship emits required V1.5 keys (story, evidence, evidence_ladder, confidence, diagnostics) with non-empty evidence_ladder containing claim_label / claim / cluster_theme / supporting_signals / lens_contributions / technical_refs / provenance_status; diagnostics.provenance_rollup present; knowledge_graph.cross_cuts has by_domain / by_layer / by_mechanic / by_time_scope / by_provenance_status / by_evidence_type. V1 backward-compat keys (story.headline, story.summary, evidence.why_mirror_sees_this, evidence.lens_contributions, evidence.technical_refs, confidence.level/score, diagnostics.engine_version) all preserved. Frontend bundle entry-3e953d2b932326e155247fb46bc501d1.js is in /app/backend/web_dist (old entry-7834caef... no longer present); compiled bundle contains 'relationship_synthesis' (2x) and 'MIRROR SEES' (1x) markers. forum_hd_mapping.py imports synthesize_relationship and writes mapping['relationship_synthesis'] (line 1896). Frontend mappings.tsx reads relationship_synthesis (line 298) and renders the new MIRROR SEES section gated on its presence (line 319). No code modifications. Read-only verification per request.
action_items: User Publish step still required: production bundle is currently the OLD entry-7834caef... — user must re-publish for V1.5 synthesis renderer + backend orchestrator to reach prod (per request scope; not a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: mirror_reflection_orchestrator.py defines both ORCHESTRATOR_VERSION_OLD and ORCHESTRATOR_VERSION_V15 constants (lines 121-122) that are unused — only ORCHESTRATOR_VERSION (v1.5) is referenced. Harmless but dead code; consider removing.

Default fallback for layer override when 'opportunity' / 'repair_pathway' substring is present is fine, but _LAYER_OVERRIDES uses first-match-wins on raw substring; 'today' before 'memory' could mis-bucket strings containing 'today's memory'. Low risk given current signal sources.

Frontend bundle gating only on relationship_synthesis.story is correct, but mappings.tsx should also defensively handle the case where evidence_ladder is empty (already non-empty in tested payloads, but useful guard).
